WASD / arrows — throttle & steer
Space — brake · Shift — cruise control

THE AFTERGLOW FIELD GUIDE

Find your own pace.

Ease forward with W or ↑. Turn with A / D or ← / →. S slows you down and gently reverses. Space drops your speed. Shift holds your cruising speed.

In Sunset voyage, sail close to seven cyan signals to piece together a farewell broadcast. There’s no timer, no score, and no way to lose. Your compass and chart lead the way. Each ride has its own pace.

Free sail keeps generating islands as you go. Turn anywhere. Follow nothing. Just be here.

Drag the mouse to look around. C changes the camera. R brings you back to open water. M toggles the synthesized soundtrack. Escape pauses.
